_**Agent (composer-2-fast)**_

Here’s a concise review of your **approach** against 4g / 4h and the trigger UX — **no code edits**, as requested.

## 4g — Hidden input + Server Actions

**Intent (selected value → `formData.get("icon")`)**  
You need the hidden field to reflect **the chosen icon**, not the search box.

Right now the hidden input is wired to **`debouncedQuery`**:

```133:133:components/admin/icon-picker.tsx
                            <input type="hidden" name="icon" id="icon" value={debouncedQuery ?? ""} />
```

That submits whatever the user **typed** in the combobox, which can differ from (or exist without) a selection. For 4g it should follow the spec: **`value={selectedIcon ?? ""}`** (or equivalent) so submit sends the stored identifier string only after a real pick.

**Placement inside `<form>`**  
`IconPicker` is rendered **inside** `<form>` on both pages, which is correct in principle. Many Popover implementations (including Radix/shadcn) **portal** content to `document.body`. If the hidden input lives only inside `PopoverContent`, it may end up **outside** the `<form>` in the DOM, so the browser might **omit** `icon` on submit. Worth verifying in DevTools: after open, is the hidden input still under your `<form>`? If not, the fix is usually to render the hidden input **outside** the portaled content but still inside the form (e.g. next to the trigger), or use a non-portaled content container if your UI library allows it.

So: **value binding** and **portal vs form subtree** are the two main things to align with 4g.

## 4h — Default for edit

You’re using **`fullName?: string`** and `useState(..., fullName ?? null)` instead of a prop named **`defaultValue`**. Behavior matches the idea of “optional initial icon id from the server”; only the **API name** differs from the task text. Passing `fullName={skill.icon ?? undefined}` on the edit page is the right idea.

One subtlety (true for any `defaultValue`-style prop): state is only initialized on **mount**. If the same component instance ever reused with a **different** skill without remounting, initial state wouldn’t update — uncommon for full page navigations, but good to be aware of.

## PopoverTrigger — Icon + label vs placeholder

You do show **`IconPreview`** next to text when something is selected, and placeholder copy when not — that matches **4h**’s display idea.

Details to refine when you implement:

- Trigger currently prints **`selectedPicked.fullName`** (full `"name | pack"` string). The spec asked for something closer to an **icon name** next to the glyph; you might prefer showing **`getIconName()`** (and maybe pack in muted text) instead of the raw pipe string — UX preference, not strictly “wrong.”
- **`IconPreview`** falls back to `<span>a</span>` while loading — that reads like a temporary debug placeholder; a small skeleton or empty space would match a polished trigger.

## Small extras (not in the task, but relevant)

- **`console.log("300 ms")`** in the debounce effect will spam the console in dev.
- Edit page imports **`WithCustomLoading`** `dynamic(...)` but doesn’t use it; **`IconPicker`** is imported directly — dead code / confusion only.

---

**Bottom line:** Your **state model** (`selectedIcon` + `IconPreview` on the trigger) and **edit default via a prop** are on the right track. For 4g, **`debouncedQuery` on the hidden input is the wrong source of truth**; confirm **portal** doesn’t take the hidden field out of the form. After those two checks, your approach matches the transcript’s 4g/4h intent.
